cells.name: E-10 slider own release
cells.line: Tab in: largest one-frame centre move 0.0 px · Tab out of the engaged slider: ×1.060 → ×1.000, largest one-frame drop per 16.7 ms 0.0060, largest centre move 0.0 px (the references for the hand-off and Escape bounds)

cells.name: E-10 slider escape release
cells.line: Escape: ×1.060 → ×1.000, largest one-frame drop per 16.7 ms 0.0065 (bound ≤ own release 0.0060 + 0.002), largest centre move 0.0 px (bound ≤ own release 0.0 + 1 px)

cells.name: E-10 slider re-render landing
cells.line: a sibling inserted during the hold, then release: the root's largest one-frame move per 16.7 ms 1.3 px (without the insert 1.3 px; bound ≤ that + 1 px)

cells.name: E-10 slider re-render landing (layout-only)
cells.line: a spacer before the slider grown 40 px by a style write during the hold (no childList mutation; the root's top read 91.4 → 131.4 px during the hold, 132.0 px at the film's end), then release: the root's largest one-frame move per 16.7 ms 1.1 px (without the move 1.2 px; bound ≤ that + 1 px)

cells.name: E-10 slider2 hand-off drop
cells.line: Tab A → B (focus on ProbeB) · outgoing A ×1.060 → ×1.000, largest one-frame drop per 16.7 ms 0.0065 (bound ≤ own release 0.0060 + 0.002), largest centre move 0.0 px at 416 ms (bound ≤ own release 0.0 + 1 px) · incoming B ×1.000 → ×1.060, largest centre move 0.0 px at 213 ms (bound ≤ own engage 0.0 + 1 px)

cells.name: E-10 slider2 hand-off singleton fwd
cells.line: 90 frames: engaged roots per frame max 2 (24 frame(s) with two, first at 39 ms), 0 frame(s) with none · first frame A engaged true, B false · last frame B engaged true, A false (bound: at most one engaged on every frame, the incoming one at the end; selector [data-held], [data-kbd])

cells.name: E-10 slider2 hand-off veil
cells.line: veil 1.00 before the Tab, minimum 1.00 across the hand-off, 1.00 at the end (bound ≥ 0.1× its level: it does not re-ramp from 0)
